_meta.purpose: Curated list of NSE-listed names that traded during 2008-2024 but were delisted, restructured, or otherwise zeroed out — and which yfinance silently drops from the historical universe. Used by examples/nse_survivorship_estimate.py to compute a more honest survivorship penalty than the visible-exits-only baseline.
_meta.warning: This list remains INCOMPLETE on purpose: every entry is a publicly-documented major collapse where the exit event, year, and approximate equity loss can be sourced from Indian financial press. The full universe of NSE delistings/insolvencies between 2008-2024 is plausibly several hundred names; this file currently captures the largest ~30. The next planned correction layer is the NSEBhavcopyAdapter (free public data) — see examples/nse_pit_external_data.py; until that ingestion ships, treat the survivorship-drag number derived from this file as a defensible lower bound, not a final answer.

format.ticker: NSE trading symbol at time of last activity (some pre-2018 tickers used the BSE-style spelling; the math doesn't depend on the symbol being exact, only on the dates and approx_total_return_pct).
format.first_active_year: approximate year the name was actively traded (lower bound)
format.last_active_year: year the name was effectively delisted/zeroed
format.approx_total_return_pct: rough peak-to-delisting return for someone holding from first_active_year to last_active_year. Negative; conservative estimates. -90 to -98 is the typical NCLT-wipeout range; -85 used for resolutions where existing equity got partial recovery (e.g. ESSARSTEEL → ArcelorMittal).
